data.raw_text:
Coup reportedly averted in the Philippines. Ferdinand Marcos Jr nearly lost his presidency during the September 21 anti-corruption protest. Duterte plot rejected by military.

This is the scoop by noted Philippine defense writer Manuel Mogato, who reports of a plot organized by a large "Christian" denomination based in the Philippines. The head of that sect/cult reportedly met with a top Army commander days before the mass protests organized on September 21 by liberal/progressive camps, civil society and the Catholic Church against corruption - in an effort to take advantage of the protests by overthrowing the government.

Mogato claims the cult leader had promised to mobilize about 500,000 people to the Rizal Park in Manila to coincide with the mass civil protests against corruption, and then ordered them to march to Malacanang Palace to wreck havoc on it and other sites around Metro Manila, with the military swooping in to declare a withdrawal of support from Marcos and the restoration of order by a junta.

His source said there was only one problem, the cult leader wanted Vice President Sara Duterte-Carpio to take over once Marcos is removed. The military was reluctant because of the Duterte's pro-China leanings and the United States not supporting the possible rise of Sara Duterte in a regime change.

He said the Army commander turned down the cult's leader’s proposal. Instead, the Army commander suggested a revolutionary government, made of a 30-man civilian-military junta. Two members of the Roman Catholic clergy were reportedly invited to join the junta, but had been warned by their superiors not to take part in any extra-constitutional means to remove the president.

The between the cult leader and the military failed with church/cult not sending warm bodies to Manila that day and the military remaining loyal to President Marcos. The riots that broke out near Malacanang Palace in Manila on September 21st was just the remnants of a failed attempt to take down the Philippine government and install the Dutertes back in power.
